title: On curves of degree 10 with 12 triple points
summary: We construct an irreducible rational curve of degree 10 in $CP^2$ which has 12 triple points and a union of three rational quartics with 19 triple points. This gives counter-examples to a conjecture by Dimca, Harbourne, and Sticlaru. We also prove that there exists an analytic family $C_u$ of curves of degree 10 with 12 triple points which tends as $u\to 0$ to the union of the dual Hesse arrangement of lines (9 lines with 12 triple points) with an additional line. We hope that our approach to the proof of the latter fact could be of independent interest.
